'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Andy Klema LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andy Klema]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
